# Security Policy

## Supported versions

FileClerk is under active development and has no released package versions.
Security fixes currently target the latest commit on `main`.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Use GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Starbender-Systems/Starbender.FileClerk/security/advisories/new)
to submit a report. If that feature is temporarily unavailable, contact the
maintainer privately through a previously established channel before sharing
details.

Include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Reproduction steps or a proof of concept
- Affected versions or commit ranges, if known
- Suggested mitigations or fixes, if available

The maintainer will make a best effort to acknowledge the report promptly,
coordinate investigation, and communicate remediation and disclosure timing.
